fractionation method: Crosslinked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a Superdex Peptide 3.2/30 column
fragmentation method: selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
instrument: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron).
labeling: no labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
